recipe_cards.name: Pulled Pork Picnic with Cole Slaw on Taco Shells
recipe_cards.nonna_says: Listen here, honey. You rub that pork shoulder like you mean it. Brown sugar, smoked paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper. Every inch. Put it in the slow cooker, set it to low, and walk away for eight hours. When it's done, the meat should fall apart if you even look at it. Shred it with two forks, toss it back in those juices, and pile it high on your taco shells. The slaw goes on top. Cabbage, carrots, a little vinegar, a pinch of sugar, and some mayo. If you skip the slaw, you're eating dry pork in a shell and that's not a meal, that's a punishment.

groups.merge_action: mix rub, massage all over pork
place in slow cooker bottom
toss together, chill until serving

final_steps: place rubbed pork on onions in slow cooker
shred with two forks, toss in juices
pile pork on taco shells, top with slaw

recipe_cards.name: Chickpea & Broccoli Curry over Rice
recipe_cards.nonna_says: Heat the coconut oil in your big pan. Medium heat. Onions go in first until they're soft and sweet. Then garlic, ginger, and that little chili pepper if you're brave. Stir in your spices, cumin, coriander, chili powder, turmeric, and let them toast for one minute, no more. Tomato paste, then the whole can of coconut milk, stir it smooth. In go the broccoli and chickpeas, push them under the sauce. Simmer ten minutes until the broccoli still has some fight in it. Finish with coconut cream and cilantro. Anyone who says broccoli is boring just hasn't met this curry.

groups.merge_action: saute onion 3-5 min, add garlic/ginger/chili 1 min
stir spices 1 min, add paste and milk, simmer
add broccoli and chickpeas, simmer 10 min

final_steps: stir in coconut cream and cilantro

recipe_cards.name: Babo Pasta (Spinach Egg Yolk Pasta with Alfredo)
recipe_cards.nonna_says: This is Babo's pasta, so pay attention. Spinach goes in the food processor until it's smooth. Make a well of flour on the counter. Egg yolks only, no whites, and that spinach puree go in the middle. Work it together with your hands until it's a smooth green dough, then let it rest. Roll it thin, cut it how you like it. For the sauce, melt butter, pour in the cream, let it warm up gentle. Parmesan goes in off the heat, a little at a time, stirring always. This is not hard. If it breaks, your heat was too high and I told you to keep it low.

groups.merge_action: well method: yolks and spinach puree in flour well, knead 8-10 min, rest 30 min
melt butter, add cream, simmer 5 min, remove from heat, stir in cheese

final_steps: roll pasta thin, cut into fettuccine or pappardelle
boil in salted water 2-3 min (fresh cooks fast)
toss pasta in Alfredo sauce with splash of pasta water

recipe_cards.name: One-Pan Chicken Broccoli Couscous
recipe_cards.nonna_says: Season those chicken thighs with salt, garlic powder, onion powder. Skin side down in hot olive oil, don't move them for six minutes. You want golden, not pale. Flip, four more minutes, then out. Same pan, butter and lemon slices go in, sear them quick. Shallots, broccoli, couscous, toast it all two minutes. Garlic, wine, broth, Italian herbs, everything in. Chicken goes back on top, nestled in nice. Lid on, simmer twelve minutes. Dan, this is a Wednesday night dinner that looks like you tried. And you barely had to.

groups.merge_action: season chicken, sear skin-down 6 min, flip 4 min, set aside
sear lemon slices both sides, saute shallot 2 min
add broccoli and couscous, toast 2 min, garlic 30 sec, wine 1 min, then broth and herbs

final_steps: return lemon slices and chicken to pan
bring to boil, lid on, simmer 12-14 min

recipe_cards.name: American Tacos with Costco Taco Seasoning
recipe_cards.nonna_says: Brown the beef in a hot pan. Break it up good, no big chunks. Drain the fat if there's too much, but leave a little for flavor. Sprinkle the Costco taco seasoning packet over the meat, pour in a splash of water, and let it simmer until the sauce gets thick and coats everything. That's it. Warm your shells. Set out the toppings. Lettuce, tomato, cheese, sour cream. Let Elsie build her own. She'll eat twice as much when she gets to pick what goes in it. See? Taco Thursday is the easiest night of the week.

groups.merge_action: brown beef and onion 5-7 min, drain excess fat, add seasoning and water, simmer 3-5 min

recipe_cards.name: Mac & Cheese with Broccoli
recipe_cards.nonna_says: Boil your pasta in good salty water. Steam the broccoli right on top in a colander. In another pot, melt the butter, whisk in the flour, let it go golden two minutes. Now the milk goes in, warm milk if you're smart, and whisk until it thickens. Dijon mustard, just a little. Then the cheese, cheddar and gruyere, low heat, stir it in handful by handful. Fold in the pasta and broccoli. Eat it now while it's hot and perfect. If you want to get fancy, put some breadcrumbs on top and run it under the broiler. But it's Friday night, honey, you've done enough this week.

groups.merge_action: boil pasta al dente, steam broccoli on top 1-2 min, drain pasta, blanch broccoli
melt butter, whisk in flour 2 min, add warm milk, simmer and whisk 5-7 min until thick
stir into sauce off heat until melted and smooth

final_steps: fold in cooked pasta and broccoli

recipe_cards.name: Pizza Night after Elsie's YAT Play
recipe_cards.nonna_says: Tonight we celebrate. Elsie was on that stage and she was magnificent, and nobody is cooking. You call the pizza place. Get one cheese for the little one because she earned it. Get one with something good for the grown-ups, pepperoni, sausage, whatever makes you happy. When it arrives, put it on real plates. Light a candle. Pour the drinks. Just because it came in a box doesn't mean it can't feel special. And save a slice for tomorrow because cold pizza for breakfast is a reward for a good week.

groups.merge_action: order from favorite local spot 30 min before showtime ends
toss salad while pizza is en route
set a proper table because tonight matters

final_steps: serve on real plates with salad
save leftovers for Saturday morning cold pizza breakfast
